verdict.rationale: Sill runs its host on macOS and its viewer on iPhone/iPad, so host and viewer do run on different operating systems (macOS to iOS/iPadOS). Coverage is limited to Apple's ecosystem: the evidence shows no desktop viewer and no Windows, Linux or Android client or host. Missing for 10: desktop viewer clients, non-Apple platforms (Windows/Linux/Android), any host other than Mac.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: Sill shows a window from your Mac, or its whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad
